tests.test: MCP timer running/report and team presence forward the authenticated agent to real services
tests.reason: listReport sorts entries by startedAt descending after the query. The fixture stamps each row with new Date(), so a millisecond boundary swaps project ids from [15, 4060] to [4060, 15]. The prisma mock ignores orderBy and returns filter order. adminSet is only used for canManage, not result order. The same test earlier failed on presence ids [other-4060, other-15] versus [other-15, other-4060].
